# Test fixtures — synthetic or attributed only

| Folder | Content | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `images/` | a few leaf images copied from D1/D2 (CC BY 4.0) + non-leaf photos taken by the team | keep `ATTRIBUTION.md` listing dataset, file, licence |
| `malicious/` | generated harmless samples: renamed HTML/SVG, truncated JPEG, decompression-bomb PNG header, JPEG+zip polyglot | generated by `make_malicious.py` (to write) — never real malware |
| `advisory/` | canned LLM outputs + retrieved chunks for validator cases | synthetic text |

No real farmer data, phone numbers or locations, ever.
